research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Opentrons is engaged in developing systems and methods for pipette robots, including operations such as deck and pipette tip calibration, as described in 'Systems and methods for pipette robots.' The company also researches moveable stage assemblies for pipette systems, as detailed in 'Moveable stage for a pipette system.' Additionally, Opentrons is working on apparatuses for controlled release of labware and thermocycler seals, supporting automation in laboratory workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: Opentrons is a life science company that develops pipetting robot technology designed to automate experiments.

product.name: Opentrons Flex
product.description: A modular laboratory liquid-handling robot for automating pipetting and experimental workflows, with interchangeable pipettes, a plate gripper, configurable deck, touchscreen control, and on-deck modules.

product.name: OT-2
product.description: An open-source liquid-handling robot for automating laboratory pipetting and sample-preparation protocols, including workflows in molecular biology, cell biology, and education.

product.name: Opentrons Workstations
product.description: Application-specific laboratory automation configurations for workflows such as NGS, proteomics, nucleic acid extraction, PCR, protein purification, and walk-up pipetting.

product.name: Opentrons Software and Protocol Tools
product.description: A software ecosystem for designing, running, and customizing automated laboratory protocols through the Opentrons App, Protocol Designer, Protocol Library, Labware Library, Python API, and documentation.

product.name: OpentronsAI
product.description: An AI-assisted protocol development tool that converts natural-language workflow descriptions into laboratory automation code and supports simulation, verification, and deck-map editing.

product.name: Opentrons Instrument Services and Support
product.description: Technical and operational services for Opentrons instruments, including customer support, protocol assistance, field service, warranty coverage, and related implementation help.
